STU-LAY-021: span and split columns are a paragraph-level attribute ... span all or N columns ... split into sub-columns, with before/after spacing and inside/outside gutter controls; {single_column, span_columns, split_columns} with span_count.all and a separate integer N, 'Studio MUST carry both'
spec_basis_slices_2_3: STU-LAY-025/127: anchored objects attach a frame to a position in text so it travels with reflow; anchored_position inline/above_line/custom ... insert_anchored_object and release_anchored_object; a default anchored-object settings record ... MUST be carried; a member of a group cannot be re-anchored and an inline item cannot be moved beyond its container boundary; both are distinct typed errors

STU-LAY-047/151: cross-references to paragraphs or named text anchors using editable formats assembled from building blocks, with a character style ... flag stale or broken references; typed errors: destination must be a text anchor or a paragraph; named character style does not exist; delimiter must be a single character; delimiter-inclusion attribute must be exactly true or false; format string has invalid syntax

STU-LAY-049/153: named conditions hide or show tagged text ranges ... condition sets ... redefine ... deleting a condition takes a REPLACING-WITH argument ... conditional visibility resolves BEFORE composition

STU-LAY-038: pattern (regular-expression) styles apply a character style automatically to every match inside paragraphs carrying a paragraph style ... stored ON the style and MUST NOT be modelled as a separate side table

STU-LAY-039/142: object styles ... applying an object style sets fitting, text wrap, anchoring, effects targeting and export tagging in one operation; SEVENTEEN independent category-enable booleans (nineteen named); miter_limit hard 1..500; arrow-head scales hard 1..1000 percent
